title: USGS: over 96 percent of Earth's water is saline
summary: The water-science page gives the saline share, the ice share of freshwater, and how little is in rivers and lakes.
body: The U.S. Geological Survey says that of about 332.5 million cubic miles of water, over 96 percent is saline; of the freshwater, over 68 percent is locked in ice and glaciers and another 30 percent is underground; rivers and lakes hold about 22,300 cubic miles, about 1/150th of one percent of the total, and yet supply most of the water people use. The v1 article's "97 percent oceans" and "less than 1 percent available freshwater" are rougher cousins of these sentences. Use the USGS figures. The v1 numbers for evaporation share, atmospheric residence time, and ocean-circulation time were not on this page.
